dedupe_keys.name: un habitat urban indicators database global urban observatory data hub

description: The Urban Indicators Database is UN-Habitat's data hub for urban indicators, run by its Data and Analytics Section in Nairobi on an ArcGIS Hub site. The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers datasets, data visualisations, publications and guidance organised by theme and by the Sustainable Development Goals and New Urban Agenda indicators, news of the Global Urban Observatory Network (48 observatories across 41 cities after its October 2025 workshop), city-level COVID-19 case data, and maps of basic infrastructure facilities and services in informal settlements in Kenya, Uganda and South Sudan. Coverage is global at country and city level. Access is free through the hub, where datasets can be explored and downloaded; no licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: indicators come from national reporting and model estimates with uneven city coverage and years, and the home page does not list every dataset or its method. It supports reference layers for urban exposure and adaptation studies, such as access to services, slum populations and public space by city. Related records: data-unhabitat-open-spaces-green-areas-sdg-11-7-1 is one of its indicators.
